content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 7.7 was the only Customer-payable liquidated damages provision (15% of annual Fees per week after a ten-day payment delay) — a minor-breach trigger with a compounding amount capable of exceeding remaining contract value, i.e. walk-away territory, and not an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees, so it fails the fallback too. Other locations were checked and are fine for us: Section 9.4 (termination without cause, accrued Fees only), Section 27 (termination without penalty), Section 3/SLA remedies running to us, and Section 21 (mutual cap). Redline validated at the preferred level with a single surgical replace deleting the LD and confirming we pay no liquidated damages or penalties.
